sources: PlayStation official trophy list via PSNProfiles

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge. Visit a shooting range, work through its challenges one by one, and repeat any challenge where you only scored silver or bronze until you hit gold. This is a skill-based cleanup trophy, so leave it until after the story when you have better weapons and more practice. Sources: PlayStation official trophy list via PSNProfiles and Exophase.

sources: PlayStation official trophy list via PSNProfiles
